properties.name: opaa.build.commit
properties.description: Commit the running image was built from, named in the data collection disclosure; the release image sets it, empty means unknown.

properties.name: opaa.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to call /api/** from a browser on another origin.

properties.name: opaa.database.schema
properties.description: PostgreSQL schema holding every table of OPAA (ADR-0034); it must exist and belong to the database account before the first start.

properties.name: opaa.demo.chat-import.enabled
properties.description: Whether the demo seed may write prepared chat transcripts over POST /api/v1/spaces/{spaceId}/chat-imports; the route exists only while this is true.

properties.name: opaa.embedding.takeover.api-key
properties.description: Key of the embedding endpoint an installation from before ADR-0060 used; read once while no embedding model is installed.

properties.name: opaa.embedding.takeover.base-url
properties.description: Address of the embedding endpoint an installation from before ADR-0060 used; read once while no embedding model is installed.

properties.name: opaa.embedding.takeover.dimensions
properties.description: Vector size an installation from before ADR-0060 was configured with; read once while no embedding model is installed and a vector table exists.

properties.name: opaa.embedding.takeover.max-input-tokens
properties.description: Input limit in tokens of the embedding endpoint an installation from before ADR-0060 used; read once while no embedding model is installed.

properties.name: opaa.embedding.takeover.model
properties.description: Embedding model an installation from before ADR-0060 used; read once while no embedding model is installed.

properties.name: opaa.features.external-access.enabled
properties.description: Feature flag of external access: access tokens, library releases and the MCP server (ADR-0044).

properties.name: opaa.features.metadata.enabled
properties.description: Feature flag of document and library metadata (ADR-0044); off keeps only a document's title.

properties.name: opaa.features.prompt-libraries.enabled
properties.description: Feature flag of prompt libraries (ADR-0044); off hides them, their data stays.

properties.name: opaa.features.speech-input.enabled
properties.description: Feature flag of dictation in the chat input (ADR-0044); it also needs the transcription model role.

properties.name: opaa.http.force-http1
properties.description: Forces HTTP/1.1 for every RestClient connection, for OpenAI-compatible servers without HTTP/2.

properties.name: opaa.indexing.embedding-rate-estimate
properties.description: Fallback rate of the follow-up cost estimate in chunks per second, until enough embedding calls have been measured.

properties.name: opaa.spike.tool-loop.enabled
properties.description: Throwaway spike, never for production: a question starting with "@test " runs a model-driven tool-calling loop.
